summary: Custom callbacks are activated, depending on NEEDS_ENABLED, by placing them in a configured callback directory or collection and referencing them by FQCN. They load in alphanumeric order. Most shipped callbacks are disabled by default and must be listed in callbacks_enabled.
questions: How do I turn on the timer and profile_roles callbacks?
In what order do callback plugins run?
Why isn't my custom callback doing anything?
How do I enable a callback from a collection?

answer_card.title: Enabling callback plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
Most shipped callbacks are disabled by default. Enable them in `ansible.cfg`:

```ini
callbacks_enabled = timer, mail, profile_roles, collection_namespace.collection_name.custom_callback
```

Custom callbacks go in a configured callback directory or a collection (referenced by FQCN). Whether they must be listed depends on the plugin's `NEEDS_ENABLED` property. Plugins load in alphanumeric file order, so `1_first.py` runs before `2_second.py`.
